entities.summary: Lynda Chuba-Ikpeazu, also known as Lynda Chuba, is a Nigerian politician, Lawyer, model and beauty pageant titleholder. She gained popularity as the first ever Most Beautiful Girl in Nigeria 1986. She is the daughter of former Chief Justice and two-time NFA chairman Chuba Ikpeazu. She is also one of 11 female out of the 360 lawmakers at the chamber in Nigeria.
